name: Lost Luggage
description: A bonus crate of holiday and travel oddities.

medium: a phrasebook for the wrong country
I packed four hats and no socks.
The seagull took my boarding pass.
We've passed that same cow three times.
I only speak enough to order soup.
The tent was fine until the goat arrived.
Apparently the donkey has right of way.
I've been wearing the same poncho since Tuesday.
The tour guide left without us on purpose.
Somebody declared a pineapple at customs.
The pedalo has a mind of its own.
hard: My suitcase went on a nicer holiday than I did.
I got sunburnt in the shape of a sandal.
That's not on the map, and neither are we.
The lifeguard said I'm not allowed to do that again.
I'm sure the hotel was facing the other way yesterday.
We took a wrong turn at the giant lobster.
